Question
========
What characterises the "downsize and distribute" strategy described by Lazonick?

Answerlist
----------
* Profits are paid out to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks rather than reinvested in workers and products
* Profits are reinvested in skills, pay, and new products
* Firms reduce executive pay to save jobs
* Firms distribute shares to all employees

Solution
========
Since the 1980s, many firms shifted from retain-and-invest to downsize-and-distribute, which favours shareholders and executives.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
